component.name: LoopCam
component.summary: Minimalist virtual camera and audio routing suite

description.p: LoopCam is a native Debian application designed to bridge the gap between your media sources and your communication apps. Whether you need to loop a local video file as a webcam, route an IP camera stream into a meeting, or mix your desktop audio into a virtual microphone, LoopCam handles it with a distraction-free GTK3 interface.
Built with a human-centric philosophy, it relies on minimal system dependencies like v4l2loopback and PulseAudio, ensuring your system remains light and responsive.
Initial release of LoopCam featuring virtual webcam creation, IP camera piping, and RhythmRoute audio integration.
